experiment: D1 cold whole-body actor parameter direction, reset-only diagnostic 95

development.input: round 1, training episodes j=0,1,2 per seed, t0 only
development.direction: One hypothetical initial Adam displacement, minimizing mean absolute world-x departure from t0 over ticks 1..32, averaged over three starts
development.optimizer: fresh Adam, default betas and epsilon
development.seal: seal all possible directions then all holdout model predictions prior to first holdout native decision

task: native D1 4 degree uphill at x=1.10 m, same 1-tick action FIFO, delayed range feedback, original PD, no fixed wheel offset or exploration
reward: negative mean of abs(x[t]-physical_x[0]), t=1..32, in metres

measures.per_radius: (R(+h)-R(-h))/(2*h), h=0.5,1.0; for both native and model
measures.native_direction: both slopes positive, mutually agree, both agree with the analytic validation-start gradient dotted with the sealed parameter displacement, R(+h)>R(0) for both h
measures.model_internal: report agreement of analytic and both model finite differences
measures.cell: all five H32 native arms complete without fall, truncation, or illegal contact; five model arms numerically complete without its predicted fall; native direction and model internal checks pass
measures.overall: 9/9 cells; no replacement, averaging across failures, or shorter-horizon promotion
measures.terminal: if first contact on tick32 preserve numeric return and fail safety; before tick32 return is missing

retention: one attempt per stage; preserve early stops, traces, missing arms and failures; no resuming a partial run
